description: Evaluates the completeness of the client onboarding workflow, ensuring all touchpoints from lead capture through kickoff meeting are present and properly sequenced.

criteria.question: Is SMS sent within 60 seconds of lead capture? (yes/no)
Does the ClickUp project use a template? (yes/no)
Is a Lark channel created with #client-name format? (yes/no)
Does the kickoff email include timeline and deliverables? (yes/no)
Is Notion workspace created with standard pages? (yes/no)
Are team members assigned based on project scope? (yes/no)
